question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Quaint
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"quaint"** means attractively unusual or old-fashioned. (अनोखा, पुराना लेकिन आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example: **The village has a **quaint** charm with its cobblestone streets and old-fashioned shops.
 
 
 
• **"Ordinary" **refers to something with no special or distinctive features; normal. (साधारण)
 
 
• **Example: **The meal was quite **ordinary**, nothing special about it.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'quaint' **is **'ordinary'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brisk** (तेज़): Active, fast, and energetic.

 
 
• **Example:** She set off at a brisk pace for her morning walk.
 
 
 
• **Ridiculous **(मूर्खतापूर्ण): Deserving or inviting mockery; absurd.
 
 
• **Example: **His idea of a flying car seemed ridiculous to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Distinct** (स्पष्ट): Recognizably different in nature from something else of a similar type.
 
 
• **Example:** The two species are quite distinct from each other.
 
 

3c:Tf00,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
